# Options and observations

Paper: £30 a year, works offline, updates require a visit.
Online: £96 a year, immediate updates, requires a smartphone and connectivity.
Hybrid: paper remains authoritative, online copy available, £110 a year, extra reconciliation work.

For the isolated label-printer choice, Alpha and Beta use identical paper and power. Both pass every required label format. Alpha costs £40 and Beta costs £65. There is no evidence that Alpha is less reliable. Do not infer differences that were not measured.

A previous storage review found the cupboard adequate for 20 boxes. This depended on a verified dry roof and a 20-box limit. A later inspection found an active roof leak. The old verdict is retained in previous-review.md as historical evidence.
